app: Contrast control (synthetic): a team creates codes in App Store Connect on the day of a campaign with eligibility left at defaults and no recorded decision, prints them on flyers, and adds a single English-only Redeem button on the paywall that presents the redemption sheet and then checks a completion flag the sheet never provides -- successful redeemers are told the code failed. There is no delegate or CustomerInfo listener, the delegate is registered lazily from the paywall, there is no redemption URL, no departure record and no sync on return, and no restore button. The subscription model has a single isPremium boolean fed from a cached flag, and a redeemed free period is counted as a trial start. Nothing is keyed to the offer's reference name, code expiry lives only in the console nobody reopens, and the flow was never tried with sandbox codes.
